# **PixelWell Design System Specification**

## **2D Retro 8-Bit Cozy Aesthetic Guideline**

This document establishes the visual, typographic, structural, and mathematical standards for **PixelWell**. All code generated by Claude Code agents must adhere strictly to these guidelines to ensure consistency, crispness, and responsive scaling.

## **1\. Typography & Web Fonts**

To preserve the vintage pixel-art look, all anti-aliasing should be minimized, and text must scale on a rigid grid.

| Font Family | Primary Role | Sizing / Scale | Fallback | CSS Rules |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **"Press Start 2P"** | Headers, Buttons, UI Labels, Emoji Counts | 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px | monospace | font-smooth: never; \-webkit-font-smoothing: none; |
| **"VT323"** | User Written Wishes (Body Text), Modals | 16px, 20px, 24px | monospace | font-smooth: never; \-webkit-font-smoothing: none; |

*Note: Always import these from Google Fonts or local assets. Sizing must be in multiples of 4px or 8px to maintain integer pixel alignments.*

## **2\. Color Palette (8-Bit Cozy Twilight)**

A cozy, magical twilight palette featuring deep mystic shades offset by warm, inviting tones.

| ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐│  \#1E122B  (Midnight Purple \- Space & Shadows)            │├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤│  \#3D2554  (Deep Amethyst \- Active Well Stone)            │├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤│  \#5A9E87  (Moss Green \- Well Vines & Details)            │├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤│  \#32B6B4  (Magic Teal \- Wishing Water Surface)          │├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤│  \#FF7373  (Coral Sunset \- Primary UI Action)             │├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤│  \#FFE699  (Soft Butter \- Warm Text / Lantern Glow)       │└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ |
| :---- |

* **Primary Background:** \#1E122B  
* **Well Base Stonework:** \#3D2554  
* **Water Element:** \#32B6B4  
* **Accent/Emphasized Elements:** \#FF7373  
* **Text (High Contrast):** \#FFE699

## **3\. Pixel-Perfect Rendering Rules (Global CSS)**

To prevent modern browsers from interpolating, blurring, or anti-aliasing the 2D pixel drawings and low-resolution assets, enforce these properties globally:

| /\* Core Rendering Directives \*/img, canvas, .pixel-art {  image-rendering: \-moz-crisp-edges;         /\* Firefox \*/  image-rendering: \-webkit-crisp-edges;      /\* Safari \*/  image-rendering: pixelated;                /\* Chrome, Edge, Opera \*/  image-rendering: crisp-edges;              /\* Standard \*/}/\* Base Body Setup \*/body {  background-color: \#1E122B;  color: \#FFE699;  font-family: 'VT323', monospace;  overflow-x: hidden;  margin: 0;  padding: 0;} |
| :---- |

## **4\. Layout Mechanics & Mathematical Transforms**

### **F4.1: Camera Pitch Transformation (Scroll Logic)**

We translate scroll position ![][image1] (where ![][image2] is the top of the page and ![][image3] is the scrolled interactive section) to transition the well.

The 3D transformation matrix of the well container is controlled via CSS custom properties mapped to scroll depth:

* **State 1 (Scroll depth ![][image4] \- Profile View):**  
  ![][image5]  
* **State 2 (Scroll depth ![][image6] \- Isometric View):**  
  ![][image7]

| /\* Container CSS Setup \*/.well-viewport {  perspective: 1000px;  overflow: hidden;}.well-3d-wrapper {  transition: transform 0.1s linear; /\* Smoothly interpolated via scroll handler \*/  transform-style: preserve-3d;} |
| :---- |

## **5\. UI Elements & Component Anatomy**

### **F5.1: Retro Pixel Borders (CSS Borders)**

Avoid standard smooth CSS border curves. Instead, build staircased borders using multiple pixel layers or a solid dual-border stroke.

| /\* Classic 8-Bit Double Border Box \*/.pixel-box {  border: 4px solid \#FFE699;  outline: 4px solid \#1E122B;  background-color: \#3D2554;  padding: 12px;  box-shadow: inset \-4px \-4px 0px 0px \#1E122B;} |
| :---- |

### **F5.2: Step-Action Interactive Buttons**

Buttons must look chunkier and "depress" when clicked.

| .pixel-btn {  font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;  font-size: 12px;  background-color: \#FF7373;  color: \#1E122B;  border: 4px solid \#1E122B;  padding: 8px 16px;  cursor: pointer;  box-shadow: \-4px 4px 0px 0px \#3D2554;  transform: translate(4px, \-4px);  transition: all 0.05s ease;}.pixel-btn:active {  box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px \#3D2554;  transform: translate(0px, 0px);} |
| :---- |
